_readme: Hand-written translations of the demo seed's member-written content, loaded into the content_translations
Why this file exists: the translation cache is normally filled by the model, either lazily on read or up
front via apps/api/scripts/translate-content.ts. Both need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The GitHub Pages demo has no
server and is built from recorded fixtures, so without a pre-warmed cache it can never show the feature at
all. These rows make the demo reproducible and free: same mechanism, same table, just a deterministic
source instead of a paid one.
Keys are the exact Korean source string, which is also how the cache is keyed. A key whose source no
longer appears in the seed is reported by apps/api/test/content-translation.test.ts, so this file cannot
drift away from the data it describes.
